Fetched and parsed COMPLETE through the JSON API (never the HTML prerender): manifest.json HTTP 200 (snapshotDate 2026-09-15) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 162,488 B, 44 blocks. Selected by WHITELIST — categoryType in {dps, hps, tank} AND sortField "lowerBound" AND keyRange undefined — giving 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows with 0 unmatched classSpec names; the melee/ranged subsets were excluded rather than merely blacklisting "dungeon". The rankings file itself was diffed, not just the manifest date, because a frozen snapshotDate is not evidence the data is frozen: all 40 lowerBound values and all 40 numberOfCharacters are IDENTICAL to stored at the stored 1-decimal precision, so nothing moved and nothing was re-stamped. partial because asOf is the SOURCE's own snapshotDate and it has not advanced past 2026-09-15 — a NINETEEN-day-old coverage date in a NINTH consecutive frozen week, well past this requirement's maxAgeDays of 8, so the staleness heartbeat going red on wowmeta is the correct and intended signal. The letters this source publishes are deliberately still not ingested.

That is inside this requirement's maxAgeDays of 8, which is sized to upstream's roughly weekly cadence, so this is the normal mid-week state and no date was touched to hide it. Subtlety Rogue's stored 2026-09-23 profile is RETAINED unchanged (the leave-the-stored-aggregate-standing precedent), keeping the stored pool at 24 profiles. 12.1.5 is not live (Blizzard dates it 13 October NA / 14 October EU) and neither PHASES.livePatch.since nor LABEL_FLIP_DUE is set, so the 12.1.5 wholesale-adoption hold does not apply and current charts merge as normal.
